threats.name: DecreaseCriticalCnt no lower bound — integer underflow
threats.call_chain: DecreaseCriticalCnt → g_count = g_count - 1 → g_count == 0 branch unreachable when g_count < 0
threats.source_evidence: critical_handler.cpp:48-56: g_count declared as int32_t, decremented unconditionally without lower bound check. g_count == 0 branch only handles zero, not negative values. Underflow carries correction.
counter_evidence_checked: No lower bound check before decrement
threats.mitigation: Add lower bound check: if (g_count <= 0) return; before decrement

threats.name: Seed value not zeroed before free in identity_group.c
threats.call_chain: GeneratePsk/AuthGeneratePsk → HcFree(seedVal) without prior memset_s
threats.source_evidence: identity_group.c:552,559,565: HcFree(seedVal) called at three locations without prior secure zeroization. ClearFreeUint8Buff exists in codebase but not used here.
threats.mitigation: Call memset_s(seedVal, SEED_LEN, 0, SEED_LEN) before HcFree(seedVal)

threats.name: Account-related group membership bypass
threats.call_chain: GaIsDeviceInGroup → check authForm → AUTH_FORM_ACROSS_ACCOUNT/AUTH_FORM_IDENTICAL_ACCOUNT → unconditional return true
threats.source_evidence: group_auth_data_operation.c:187: For AUTH_FORM_ACROSS_ACCOUNT and AUTH_FORM_IDENTICAL_ACCOUNT, device membership check returns true unconditionally. P2P groups DO verify properly.
threats.mitigation: Add proper device membership verification for account-related groups

threats.name: Credential listener callback invoked under mutex — re-entrancy deadlock
threats.call_chain: OnCredAdd/OnCredDelete/OnCredUpdate → LockHcMutex(g_credListenerMutex) → callback invocation while holding lock → re-entrancy deadlock
threats.source_evidence: cred_listener.c:47,68,89: LockHcMutex acquired before invoking external callbacks. If callback re-enters device_auth API that acquires same mutex, deadlock occurs.
counter_evidence_checked: External callbacks are unknown third-party code
threats.mitigation: Release mutex before invoking external callbacks, or use recursive mutex

threats.name: Task queue has no capacity limit — unbounded growth
threats.call_chain: PushTask → pushBack without capacity check → vector grows unbounded
threats.source_evidence: hc_task_thread.c:40-55: PushTask appends to task vector via pushBack without checking current size or enforcing capacity limit.
threats.mitigation: Add MAX_TASK_QUEUE_SIZE limit with rejection when full

threats.name: Global session slots have no per-source limit — single source exhaustion
threats.call_chain: CheckEnvForOpenSession → curSessionNum check against global MAX_AUTH_SESSION_COUNT=10 only → no per-appId/per-UID limit
threats.source_evidence: dev_session_mgr.c:86-101: Session creation checks curSessionNum against MAX_AUTH_SESSION_COUNT=10 globally. Single caller can exhaust all 10 slots.
counter_evidence_checked: No per-UID or per-appId counter exists
threats.mitigation: Add per-UID session cap alongside global limit

threats.name: Credential ID generated with timestamp — predictable identifier
threats.call_chain: AddCredential → CombineBaseCredId → Int64ToString(HcGetCurTimeInMillis)
threats.source_evidence: identity_operation.c:87: credId generation uses HcGetCurTimeInMillis() timestamp without random component — predictable within millisecond window
counter_evidence_checked: No random component added to credId
threats.mitigation: Add random suffix to credential ID generation

threats.name: Shared key material in malloc buffer not zeroed after use
threats.call_chain: GetSharedKeyFromOutJson → HcMalloc(sharedKeyLen) → GetByteFromJson → return sharedKeyVal → HcFree without prior memset
threats.source_evidence: device_auth.c:1134-1146: sharedKeyVal allocated via HcMalloc filled with session key bytes, freed at line 1141 without secure zeroization
counter_evidence_checked: HcFree calls free() which does not zero memory
memset_s+HcFree pattern used in iso_task_common.c but not here
threats.mitigation: Call memset_s before HcFree for key material buffers

threats.name: NULL dereference in session state machine on edge case
threats.call_chain: SessionSwitchState → StartAuthSubSession(self) → NULL check then dereference
threats.source_evidence: auth_sub_session.c:62-75: StartAuthSubSession NULL check returns error but caller dispatch may not validate
counter_evidence_checked: All callers appear to check return values
NULL check exists at function entry
threats.mitigation: Add defensive NULL guard in dispatch layer

threats.name: File path constructed via sprintf_s — no parent dir validation
threats.call_chain: InitCredDatabase → GetOsAccountCredInfoPathCe → sprintf_s with osAccountId
threats.source_evidence: credential_data_manager.c:164: sprintf_s with osAccountId interpolated into path; sprintf_s prevents overflow but not path traversal via crafted osAccountId
counter_evidence_checked: realpath() not called before file access
threats.mitigation: Validate osAccountId >= 0 and canonicalize path

threats.name: KeyAgree sessionKey.length + 1 used as copy size — overflow risk
threats.call_chain: ProcessTransmitCallback → memcpy_s(dest, sessionKey.length + 1, src, sessionKey.length)
threats.source_evidence: key_agree_sdk.c:285-300: memcpy_s uses sessionKey.length + 1 as destination size, risking off-by-one if length is UINT32_MAX
counter_evidence_checked: sessionKey.length originates from protocol message size field
memcpy_s provides bounds checking but +1 may still overflow
threats.mitigation: Check sessionKey.length < UINT32_MAX before adding 1

threats.name: IPC permission check limited to UID-based access control
threats.call_chain: IPC stub → CheckPermission(methodId) → UID comparison only
threats.source_evidence: permission_adapter.cpp:192: CheckPermission validates calling UID without checking SELinux context or process identity
counter_evidence_checked: SELinux provides additional MAC at kernel level
threats.mitigation: Add SELinux context verification in permission check

threats.name: Dynamic plugin loaded via dlopen without signature verification
threats.call_chain: GetCredPluginFromLib → DevAuthDlsym → plugin loaded without integrity check
threats.source_evidence: dynamic_plugin_adapter.c:84-92: dlsym loads plugin functions without signature/hash verification of the .so file
counter_evidence_checked: Plugin .so on system partition requires root to modify
Attacker model (mobile_device_remote_attacker) does not have system partition write access
threats.mitigation: Verify plugin ELF signature before loading

threats.name: No audit trail for credential CRUD operations
threats.call_chain: AddCredential/DeleteCredential → DB write → no audit event emitted
threats.source_evidence: identity_service.c: CRUD operations perform DB writes without emitting security audit events
counter_evidence_checked: No security audit event structure defined
threats.mitigation: Add security audit events for credential lifecycle

threats.name: No transport-layer encryption for handshake metadata
threats.call_chain: SoftBus sendMsg → data transmitted through SoftBus transport
threats.source_evidence: soft_bus_channel.c: Protocol data transmitted through SoftBus without additional transport encryption; metadata observable
counter_evidence_checked: Metadata includes timing and message size
threats.mitigation: Consider padding or transport wrapper for metadata

threats.name: Credential DB file paths constructed from static format strings
threats.call_chain: GetOsAccountCredInfoPath → sprintf_s with hardcoded path template
threats.source_evidence: credential_data_manager.c:164: Hardcoded path template makes credential data location predictable on filesystem
threats.mitigation: Consider path randomization or alternative naming

threats.name: No rate limiting for PIN-based authentication attempts
threats.call_chain: AuthCredential → PIN verification path → no attempt counter
threats.source_evidence: device_auth.c:299: PIN-based auth path lacks rate limiting or attempt counting; repeated attempts possible
threats.mitigation: Implement exponential backoff and max attempt limit

threats.name: Session timeout not enforced — stale sessions accumulate
threats.call_chain: SessionSwitchState → JUMP_TO_FINISH_STATE → no timer-based cleanup
threats.source_evidence: dev_session_v2.c: Session state machine transitions only on protocol events; no time-based expiration
threats.mitigation: Add configurable session TTL with background cleanup

threats.name: PIN code length treated as security strength (6 chars ≠ 6 bits)
threats.call_chain: AuthCredential → pinCode field
threats.source_evidence: REJECT-005: PIN is character string not bit field. 6-char numeric PIN = 10^6 ≈ 20 bits.
counter_evidence_checked: PIN used as auth factor not entropy source
threats.mitigation: N/A — false positive
threats.fp_rationale: REJECT-005: 6字符PIN不是6bit熵。6位数字PIN有10^6≈20bit熵。代码中PIN作为认证因子使用。

threats.name: PRINT_SENSITIVE_DATA exposed peer UDID in debug logs
threats.call_chain: ProcessBindRequest → PRINT_SENSITIVE_DATA(PeerUdid, deviceId)
threats.source_evidence: REJECT-003: PRINT_SENSITIVE_DATA only outputs 4 chars + ****; debug logging is compile-time disabled in release builds
counter_evidence_checked: Output truncated to 4 chars + mask in release
threats.mitigation: N/A — false positive
threats.fp_rationale: REJECT-003: PRINT_SENSITIVE_DATA 仅输出前4字符+****。LOGD在release构建中编译时禁用。
